findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Commute/Defs.lean:147 `theorem pow_left (h : Commute a b) (n : ℕ) : Commute (a ^ n) b`; Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Commute/Units.lean:36 `theorem units_inv_left : Commute (↑u) a → Commute (↑u⁻¹) a`; Defs.lean:103 `mul_left (hac) (hbc) : Commute (a * b) c`. In every case `_left` names the left argument of the conclusion.
findings.fix: Rename all six to `_left_of_commute` (e.g. `commute_semisimplePart_left_of_commute`, `commute_coe_unipotentPart_left_of_commute`), or drop to dot notation `Commute.semisimplePart_left`, and update the `## Main declarations` lists and call sites.
findings.issue: `commute_semisimplePart_right_of_commute : Commute g h → Commute (semisimplePart g) h` puts the modified operand in the LEFT argument of the conclusion, so the `_right` suffix is inverted. Same defect at lines 74 (`commute_coe_semisimplePart_right_of_commute`), 83 (`commute_coe_unipotentPart_right_of_commute`), 99 (`commute_unipotentPart_right_of_commute`), and in TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Representation/JordanDecomposition/Commuting.lean lines 60 and 71 — six declarations plus their module docstring entries.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn "cross_commute" mathlib/Mathlib` — no hits; the proof body is literally `(hac.mul_left hbc).mul_right (had.mul_left hbd)`, i.e. a `Commute`-namespace composite of Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Commute/Defs.lean:97,103.
findings.fix: Name it `Commute.mul_mul` (hypotheses `Commute a c`, `Commute a d`, `Commute b c`, `Commute b d`; conclusion `Commute (a * b) (c * d)`) so it is discoverable next to `Commute.mul_left`/`mul_right` and usable as `hac.mul_mul had hbc hbd`.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.commute_mul_mul_of_cross_commute` invents the term `cross_commute`, which names no predicate in Mathlib or this repo, and sits outside the `Commute` namespace despite being the exact `Commute.mul_left`/`Commute.mul_right` shape.

findings.evidence: Line 70-72: `theorem commute_ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction (g h : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) (hgh : Commute g h)`; contrast `IsUnipotentPoint.mul_of_commute` (UnipotentPoint/Basic.lean:160) and the six `_of_commute` names added in JordanChevalley/Commuting.lean.
findings.fix: Rename to `commute_ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction_of_commute` (or `Commute.ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction` for dot notation on `hgh`), and update the docstring entry at line 29 and the three call sites.
findings.issue: `Comodule.commute_ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction` reads as an unconditional claim that point actions commute, but it has a `Commute g h` hypothesis. Every sibling introduced by this PR uses the `_of_commute` suffix for the same hypothesis.

findings.evidence: The adjacent lemma at line 299 names both operands explicitly: `semisimplePart_mul_unipotentPart : semisimplePart g * unipotentPart g = g`.
findings.issue: `unipotentPart_eq_inv_mul : unipotentPart g = (semisimplePart g)⁻¹ * g` does not say which factor is inverted; `inv_mul` reads just as naturally as `g⁻¹ * _`.

summary: The centralizer lemmas carry a `_right` suffix that is inverted relative to Mathlib's `Commute.pow_left`/`units_inv_left` convention (the modified operand is the left argument of the conclusion's `Commute`), repeated in six declarations. Three smaller naming issues: invented `cross_commute` terminology, a missing `_of_commute`, and an ambiguous `inv_mul`.
